identity.name: AirYatra Design System
identity.vibe: A blend of Swiss Air Traffic Control (functional, high contrast) and Private Aviation Concierge (warm, exclusive).

usage_rules: Overlines (labels) must be Uppercase, text-xs, tracking-widest (0.2em).
Do not use Inter for headings. Use Chivo for that technical, sturdy aero look.

primary.name: Aviation Navy
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, dark mode backgrounds

accent.name: Safety Orange
accent.usage: Critical CTAs (Book Now), Alerts. Use sparingly (max 10% of screen).

technical.name: Blueprint Blue
technical.usage: Grid lines, active borders, technical markers

rules: Never use pure black (#000000). Use Slate-950 (#020617).
Dark mode is 'Cockpit Mode': Deep Slate backgrounds with high-contrast neon blue/orange accents.
Light mode is 'Hangar Mode': Stark white/grey with deep navy text.

glassmorphism.usage: Floating headers, modal overlays, dashboard widgets

borders.special: Add 'corner markers' (pseudo-elements) to important cards to look like a HUD.

shadows.glow: shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(56,189,248,0.3)] (Use for active states in dark mode)

spacing.scale: Generous. Use p-8 or p-12 where others use p-4.

grids.marketing: The Tetris Grid (Asymmetrical). Mix col-span-8 (Hero) with col-span-4 (Detail).
grids.dashboard: The Control Room Grid. Dense, 4-column layout. Gap-4. 100% width utilization.

alignment.text: Left aligned mostly. Center only for massive hero slogans.

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-sm px-8 py-3 font-medium tracking-wide shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-slate-300 text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-sm px-8 py-3
buttons.accent: bg-orange-500 text-white hover:bg-orange-600 rounded-sm px-8 py-3 shadow-orange-500/20

cards.base: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg p-6 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all

inputs.style: h-12 bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 rounded-sm

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds unless it's a subtle noise texture.
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
For Dashboards: Use the 'Control Room' grid. High density, no wasted space.
For Marketing: Use the 'Tetris' grid. Asymmetry and large imagery.
Dark mode is mandatory for the Operator Dashboard to reduce eye strain during night ops.
